# harmoniq_workspace (Resource)

A workspace in an organization. Needs an organization API key with the `admin` scope. New workspaces come with a `default` host app (environments `staging` and `production`); import it as `harmoniq_host_app` to manage it, or add your own host apps. Destroying the workspace deletes everything in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harmoniq_workspace" "checkout_team" {
  organization                 = "acme"
  slug                         = "checkout-team"
  name                         = "Checkout team"
  retention_days               = 90
  allow_ephemeral_environments = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `organization` (String) Slug of the organization that owns the workspace.
- `slug` (String) Workspace slug: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Appears in manifest URLs.

### Optional

- `allow_ephemeral_environments` (Boolean) Whether deploys may create preview environments (e.g. `pr-123`).
- `retention_days` (Number) Days of version history and snapshots kept (1–3650).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace slug.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harmoniq_workspace.checkout_team acme/checkout-team
```
